dedupe_keys.name: dafni data analytics facility for national infrastructure

description: DAFNI is a computing platform for advanced research into national infrastructure, including transport, water, energy and city-scale modelling. It is a programme within the Scientific Computing Department of the Science and Technology Facilities Council, part of UK Research and Innovation, and represents an 8 million pound investment from the UK Collaboratorium for Research on Infrastructure and Cities (UKCRIC). It aims to improve infrastructure through better sharing and use of data, simulation and optimisation, and engagement with stakeholders through visualisation, letting researchers scale and integrate their computational models; the site also runs a fellowship programme and Centre of Excellence projects. Access is through registration for the platform and is aimed at UK academic research, free at the point of use. Caveats: models and data hosted there carry their own licences and visibility settings, many are private to projects, and the platform is not a public data portal. It supports capacity planning, resilience and climate adaptation studies of interdependent infrastructure and digital-twin research, and hosts models such as the NISMOD sector models catalogued here.
